identity.title: Add evidence-backed approval records without building an approval workflow service

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Represent explicit approval requirements and outcomes as source-neutral projection records with subject, approver/principal ref when supplied, decision/native value, timestamp and evidence refs. Emit bounded approval governance signals; do not create queues, users or workflow APIs. Dependency: 8033.project-governance-context-refs.
human_pressure.why_now: Approval is a core accountability fact ('who approved it?'), but the current phase should observe and evaluate approval evidence before Ailuros owns live approval workflow.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.

machine_core.goal: Add deterministic post-run approval evidence projection and signals.
invariants: Depends on: 8033.project-governance-context-refs. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Approval is distinct from authority and distinct from identity.
Approval evidence may reference principal/invocation/policy context but does not create them.
contracts: ApprovalRecord is a post-run governance fact, not a live task object.
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Define minimal ApprovalRecord
details: subject/action, required flag when explicit, approval status/native decision, optional approver_ref, timestamp, evidence_refs/source metadata.
Keep producer-native decision value; do not force all systems into one approval enum beyond the minimal normalized state.

steps.title: Project explicit approval evidence
details: Create records only from explicit normalized approval/review evidence.
Missing approval data remains unknown/absent; successful execution is not proof of approval.

steps.title: Emit narrow approval signals
details: approval_required_unresolved only when evidence says approval was required and no resolving approval/denial is present.
approval_denied only from explicit denial/rejection evidence.

steps.title: Prove no workflow service creep
details: Tests require no HTTP writes, queues, identity directory, notification system or human task service.
Reference producers use the same generic record path.

acceptance: Approval records are deterministic, source-neutral and evidence-linked.
Successful execution does not imply approval.
Explicit unresolved requirement and denial produce distinct signals.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/core/execution.py src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/signals.py tests/test_approval_governance.py

must_check: Approval facts are observed/projection facts only.
reject_if: Approval is inferred from execution success.
An approval queue/workflow engine or user directory is added.
A source-specific approval branch is introduced.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
